title: triticum repens subsp. intermedium
intro: Triticum repens subsp. intermedium, commonly known as intermediate wheatgrass, is a type of grass native to Asia and Europe, known for its ability to grow in poor soil conditions and its fast growth rate. Intermediate wheatgrass is valued for its health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of intermediate wheatgrass include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce stress, and promote relaxation, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of intermediate wheatgrass include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
